title: Construct Binary Tree From Traversals
description: Given two integer arrays `preorder` and `inorder`, construct the binary tree and output its postorder traversal.
input_format: First line contains integer `n`. Second line has `preorder`. Third line has `inorder`.
hints: The first element in preorder traversal is always the root.
Locate root in inorder: elements to the left form left subtree, right form right subtree.
Recurse on subtrees and append root last for postorder.

reference_solution:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    n = int(data[0])
    pre = [int(x) for x in data[1:1+n]]
    ino = [int(x) for x in data[1+n:1+2*n]]
    ino_map = {v: i for i, v in enumerate(ino)}
    post = []
    def build(pre_l, pre_r, in_l, in_r):
        if pre_l > pre_r: return
        root_val = pre[pre_l]
        mid = ino_map[root_val]
        left_size = mid - in_l
        build(pre_l + 1, pre_l + left_size, in_l, mid - 1)
        build(pre_l + left_size + 1, pre_r, mid + 1, in_r)
        post.append(str(root_val))
    build(0, n - 1, 0, n - 1)
    print(' '.join(post))
